Market today: The mood is shaky, with some firms seeing parallels to the late 70s and recommending shorts. This volatility hits leveraged tech/chip names hard, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-36.59%) and SPAL (-24.14%) are flagged for attention. They are leveraged ETFs and are currently in drawdown.

Watch: Nvidia-backed Firmus withdrawing its IPO due to market volatility is a key signal for the chip sector.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for further chip sector weakness.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant drawdown and decay.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing exposure to this leveraged ETF due to its current losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch
